name: subscribe_github_pr
description: Subscribe this conversation to future GitHub pull request events. Not delivered: PR lifecycle events that echo this agent's OWN actions — Cursor-actored events on this agent's own working branch (its own pushes/synchronize, PR-body edits, closes) — and metadata-only churn (edited titles/bodies, labels, milestones, assignments, merge-queue and auto-merge toggles). Always delivered: all comments, reviews, and review comments — including Bugbot and Agentic Security Review activity, which shares the cursor[bot] identity — plus lifecycle events actored by humans or on any other branch. After subscribing, state what you are waiting for and end your turn; the event arrives as a follow-up notification in this conversation.
